scope.canonical_roi_policy: public dial bbox is used only for common ROI preparation outside the method boundary

algorithm_fit.role: all gradient updates and train-time cache construction

calibration.role: checkpoint, fusion, rejection-threshold, and ensemble selection only; no gradient updates

independent_validation.role: one sealed prediction pass and one final report after every model decision is frozen

development_excluded.role: never train, calibrate, select, validate, or report

pilot_gate.decision: all conditions must pass before any common-split GPU training is allowed

method.primary: PEPD direction plus V5 ScaleMark geometry plus existing Mask-Geometry uncertainty-aware progress fusion
method.input: one canonical meter ROI image only
method.output: normalized pointer progress and progress confidence
trainable_components: V5/enhanced ScaleMark geometry head matched to that PEPD backbone

v5_seed20261206.policy: architecture and split audit reference only; weights are forbidden in the formal 1080 bundle
v5_seed20261206.split_fact: all 50 independent_validation groups are inside the frozen V5 74-group validation roster and overlap the V5 651-group fit roster by zero groups
v5_seed20261206.reason: the head was optimized on historical seed20260720 backbone features; swapping in a new common-split backbone has unvalidated feature compatibility, while retaining the old backbone exposes 912/1080 validation images

pepd_seed20260720.policy: pilot and architecture reference only; checkpoint initialization is forbidden for the formal 1080 bundle

method.mask_geometry_policy: may participate only with provenance proving external-only or algorithm_fit-only fitting; otherwise retrain its learned component on algorithm_fit or omit it
method.primary_seed_policy: report all three frozen seeds and their fixed equal-weight ensemble; never select a seed on independent_validation

allowed: external generic pretraining with immutable provenance
deterministic random initialization for the matched V5/enhanced head and fusion
forbidden: any checkpoint or cache influenced by calibration gradients
any checkpoint or cache influenced by independent_validation
legacy SyncG checkpoint without group-level provenance

optimization.checkpoint_selection: minimum calibration progress MAE with coverage tie-break; selected once per seed
optimization.per_seed_bundle: one common-split PEPD backbone, one V5/enhanced head trained on that exact backbone feature distribution, and one progress-fusion state; all component identities are sealed together
optimization.fusion_selection: calibration-only fixed candidate grid declared before training

required_ablations: PEPD plus V5 plus Mask-Geometry fusion

resource_estimate_rtx4060_8gb.execution: train common-split PEPD and a matched V5/enhanced head per seed, then calibration-only progress fusion; AMP, workers 0-2; never overlap with another GPU trainer
